changelog: v0.0.1: Pure live runtime cheat menu with 33 dynamic features and C++ native sidecar. Instant F9 toggling with zero restart requirements.

creativeHover.label: Creative Mode Hovering / Flight (Personal & Native)
creativeHover.description: Allows floating stationary in mid-air and flying vertically without falling (R to ascend, F to descend, or Ctrl+H to toggle).

hoverSpeed.label: Hover Speed Multiplier %
hoverSpeed.description: Vertical ascent and descent speed while creative hovering (100% = normal, up to 500%).

infiniteHealth.label: Infinite Health / God Mode (Personal)
infiniteHealth.description: Clamps Health_Min to Health_Max and zeroes incoming damage factors. You become immune to lethal damage.

infiniteConsumables.label: Infinite Consumables (Native)
infiniteConsumables.description: Potions, food, bandages, and flasks are not consumed upon use.

infiniteShroud.label: Freeze Shroud Timer / Shroud God Mode (Native)
infiniteShroud.description: Bypasses engine shroud fog checks. Shroud timer is locked and will never tick down or kill you in the Shroud/Miasma.

oneHitKill.label: One-Hit Kill / Infinite Damage (Personal)
oneHitKill.description: Deals lethal damage on any enemy or boss hit, instantly defeating them.

critChance.label: Critical Hit Chance % (Personal)
critChance.description: Additional critical hit chance percentage (0% to 100% max).

critDamageMultiplier.label: Critical Damage % (Personal)
critDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for critical strike damage (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

meleeDamageMultiplier.label: Melee Damage % (Personal)
meleeDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for melee weapon attacks (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

rangedDamageMultiplier.label: Ranged Damage % (Personal)
rangedDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for bows and thrown weapons (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

magicDamageMultiplier.label: Magic Damage % (Personal)
magicDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for staves, wands, and spells (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

fastBowDrawSpeed.label: Rapid Bow Draw Speed (Fast Shooting)
fastBowDrawSpeed.description: Reduces bow draw delay in weapon item definitions, allowing rapid firing of arrows.

infiniteArrows.label: Infinite Arrows & Quiver (Native)
infiniteArrows.description: Bypasses arrow consumption when shooting bows. Arrows in quiver never decrease.

freeCrafting.label: Free Building (Construction Hammer) & Skill Perks (Native)
freeCrafting.description: Allows placing building blocks with the construction hammer and crafting without material checks or item consumption (native memory bypass for inventory requirements and deduction). For free prop/furniture placement and asset recipes, see sf-cheatmenu-assets.

unlockAllBlueprints.label: Unlock All Blueprints & Building Blocks (Safe Asset Pass)
unlockAllBlueprints.description: Safely unlocks all missing building blocks, furniture, and workshop blueprints without corrupting item requirements.

freeReskill.label: Free Reskill / Skill Reset (Zero Rune Costs)
freeReskill.description: Allows resetting skills at the Flame Altar with zero Rune costs.

itemAmountMultiplier.label: Resource Drop & Yield Multiplier (World/Server)
itemAmountMultiplier.description: Multiplies item quantities dropped from harvesting and mining (1x to 100x).

xpMultiplier.label: Experience (XP) Multiplier (World/Server)
xpMultiplier.description: Multiplies XP earned from combat, exploration, quests, and mining (1x = default, up to 100x).

dumbEnemies.label: Pacify World Enemies (Server/Host AI)
dumbEnemies.description: Enemies will not initiate attacks and are completely pacified.

enemyPerceptionMultiplier.label: Enemy Perception Range % (World/Server)
enemyPerceptionMultiplier.description: Detection and sight range of enemies (100% = normal, 0% = completely blind).

productionSpeedMultiplier.label: Production Station Speed (World/Server)
productionSpeedMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for furnaces, kilns, drying racks, and workbenches (1x to 50x).

plantGrowthMultiplier.label: Plant & Crop Growth Speed (World/Server)
plantGrowthMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for seedlings, farm plots, and tree growth (1x to 50x).

groups.label: Movement & Flight Cheats
groups.description: Creative hovering and vertical flight controls.

groups.label: Player Attributes & God Mode
groups.description: Invulnerability (God Mode), infinite consumables, and shroud fog immunity.

groups.label: Combat, Damage & Arrows
groups.description: Instant one-hit kill, critical strike multipliers, damage amplification, rapid bow draw, and infinite arrows.

groups.label: World Rules & Free Crafting
groups.description: Free bench crafting, blueprint unlocking, free reskill, and item drops.

groups.label: World Difficulty, XP & Production
groups.description: Passive enemy AI, perception range, XP multiplier, and accelerated workstation production / plant growth.
